items.title: Hunting down the last cases of sleeping sickness
items.summary: Sleeping sickness once killed tens of thousands of people every year. Now, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, EU-backed researchers are testing a simpler way to find and treat the last remaining cases and eliminate the disease for good.
items.selection_reason: Positive concrete result: EU-backed researchers testing a simpler method to find and treat remaining cases of sleeping sickness, aiming to eliminate disease.
